title: Ethereal
summary: ETHE'REAL, adjective Formed of ether; containing or filled with ether; as ethereal space; ethereal regions. 1. Heavenly; celestial; as ethereal messenger. 2. Consisting of ether or spirit. Vast chain

inlines.v: ETHE'REAL, adjective Formed of ether; containing or filled with ether; as ethereal space; ethereal regions. 1. Heavenly; celestial; as ethereal messenger. 2. Consisting of ether or spirit. Vast chain of being, which from God began, Natures ethereal human, angel, man.
